overloads.semanticRole: The REDUCE RESTORE WINDOW command reduces/expands the window whose reference number was passed in window to/from the taskbar on Windows or the dock on macOS.

constraints: Toggles rather than sets a fixed state: if window is currently displayed, it is reduced to the taskbar/dock; if window is currently reduced, it is restored to its previous state instead.
On macOS the command is asynchronous.
